The broader selected scope also requires automated consistency checks across every official plugin directory, manifest, registration, runtime/apidoc namespace and fixture. The inspected catalog tests and governance scanner do not establish that full migration-and-scan coverage, and the official plugin submodule is a separately versioned source. Keep the full-scope label unresolved rather than treating runtime validation alone as proof of completion.
